short_a: Short synthesized UI sounds for crafting, inventory and production queues. Listen to 12 free cues in your browser, then use the included WAV files in a finished game. An optional full pack contains 24 event designs with three variations each.
short_b: Give crafting and queue actions a clear sound. Queue Cues includes a free browser player and 12 usable WAV samples. The optional $5 pack has 72 files: 24 named events with three variations each.
headline: Give every little action a voice.
intro: Queue Cues is a collection of short electronic cues for game interfaces. The sounds are synthesized rather than recorded from real machines. Try the free samples at your own listening level before deciding whether they fit your project.
features:
[b]Included[/b]
[list][*]12 free WAV samples[*]Browser playback, filters and volume control[*]Optional full pack: 24 events × 3 variations = 72 WAV files[/list]
format: Mono · 48 kHz · 16-bit PCM WAV · one-shots only
license_summary: Use the included sounds in personal or commercial finished projects. Attribution is optional. Do not redistribute or sell the sounds as standalone assets. The free sampler does not license files it does not include.
limits: File and signal checks passed. Listening preference and suitability for your game still need your review. No independent human translation review or game-engine import test is claimed by this localization sample.
